# Scala Code Optimizer

Curated by Skill Harbor — a rigorous audit skill for Scala codebases: Scala 3 idiom adoption (enums, given/using, opaque types), Scala 2→3 migration cleanup, anti-pattern removal (isInstanceOf cascades, Option.get, blocking Futures), tail-recursion safety, and collection performance hygiene. Its hard rules are the interesting part: suggestions only, never in-place edits; every performance claim classified as equivalent, improved, or needs-benchmark; every idiom claim backed by a verbatim quote from official Scala docs — or marked uncited. Discovered via skills.sh, listed here with credit to its creator by @abh80. Honest caveats: Scala-only, useless outside that ecosystem; ships with companion reference files (idioms, anti-patterns, performance, citations) that must be installed with it; the rigor makes it thorough but slow — expect detailed findings, not quick fixes. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
